image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference for face/body) standing in front of a clean modern bathroom mirror in soft natural daylight. She is mid-action looking at her own reflection - her expression is direct, knowing, slightly raised eyebrow - the look of a coach who is about to tell you something honest. NOT contemplative cinematic. NOT sad. She wears practical home clothes: simple black athletic top, comfortable. Her hair is natural, slightly pulled back.
The bathroom is bright, modern, clean Italian style: white tiles, simple chrome fixtures, no clutter, natural daylight from window upper-left. The mirror shows her reflection clearly. We see her from the chest up, three-quarter angle showing both her side and the mirror reflection.
CRITICAL STYLE NOTE: This is NOT editorial cinematic mood. NOT Sofia Coppola. NOT Mediterranean golden hour. This is a PRACTICAL real coach moment - clean, direct, honest, like a fitness coach about to record an Instagram talking head. Real woman body type, no retouching, natural makeup or none. Authentic Italian woman 45 years old.
Composition: subject in center, mirror reflection visible, plenty of clean negative space TOP and BOTTOM for brand overlay (pink banner top + footer). Clean modern photography style, sharp focus, soft natural light, neutral white-balanced color (NOT warm golden-grading).

notes.note: CRITICO: Elena coach diretta, NO Sofia Coppola. Bagno PRATICO bianco moderno (NO crema Mediterraneo). Espressione "ti dico una cosa onesta" non contemplativa. Generare 4 varianti con leggere differenze di gesto/sguardo, scegliere quella piu "coach diretta".
Mantiene il pain v4 (quanti maggio, ricorsivita) MA in formato direct response brand: ALL-CAPS strategici, emoji bullets, "il problema non sei tu" come reframe esplicito brand-aligned.

Replica EXACTLY layout brand winner v2 (top banner pink + body + scarcity pill + footer split). Differenza: il body NON e nero pieno, ma foto Elena con gradient overlay scuro bottom per leggibilita headline. Headline overlay sopra foto in basso (zona piu scura grazie a gradient).
A/B test triplo: v5 (foto+brand) vs v2 (pure brand) vs v4 (foto editorial). Vedere quale aesthetic + format combo vince per Elena. CPL target 2.50€ = aggressivo (combina i vincenti).
